<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>package_private</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>x_938076_now_utils.HSBCTradeTaskUtils</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description/>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>HSBCTradeTaskUtils</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var HSBCTradeTaskUtils = Class.create();
HSBCTradeTaskUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    canAssignToMe: function(state, assignedTo, assignmentGroup) {
		//This is called from the UI Action 'Assign to Me' on the Trade Task table.  Requirement is to only allow this button to be displayed if the user is a member of the group that the task is assigned to - we have to do this server-side, hence the Script Include.

        if (state != 3 && state != 7 && assignedTo.nil() && gs.getUser().isMemberOf(assignmentGroup)) {
            return true;
        } else {
            return false;
        }

    },
	
	readyToBeSent: function() {
        var gr = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_hsbcmss_eh_hsbc_email_log");
        gr.addQuery("trade_case_task_number", current.sys_id);
        gr.addQuery('api_response_from_qtrack','!=', 'Sent Successfully');
        gr.query();
        if (gr.next()) {
            return true;
        }

    },

	//MSSRBXCE-307-401 New function created for the condition in UI Action "Ready to be sent"
	taskReadyToBeSentBtn: function() {
	    //if ((current.short_description == gs.getProperty("x_hsb11_hsbc_mss_t.sent.review") || current.short_description == gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_hsbc_mss_t.sent.trigger')) && (current.state != '3')) {
	    if ((gs.getProperty("x_hsb11_hsbc_mss_t.preview_email_tasks").includes(current.short_description)) && (current.state != '3')) {
	        var gr = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_hsbcmss_eh_hsbc_email_log");
	        gr.addQuery("trade_case_task_number", current.sys_id);
	        gr.addQuery('api_response_from_qtrack', '!=', 'Sent Successfully');
	        gr.query();
	        if (gr.next()) {
	            return true;
	        }
	    }
	},

    type: 'HSBCTradeTaskUtils'
};]]></script>
